openers.t: Dearest, please confirm receipt of one prince, slightly nervous.
Fwd: Fwd: Fwd: you. The palace has seen this. The cook wept.
Dear Sir, Madam or Valued Toaster, whichever you are, you look wonderful.
Congratulations, you have been selected, from a list of everybody, at random.
Pardon the beach shorts. My coronation ran long, and I left early.
Kindly ignore the fireworks, the band and, I fear, a second band.

q-first-date.t: Fireworks and an orchestra, booked, nothing special. URGENT: please sit next to me.
Dear Lucky Winner: dinner for two, on a yacht. The yacht is the smaller prize.

q-worst-habit.t: I bury the lede. The castle burned down in paragraph nine. I opened with the weather.
Postscripts, my treasure. Every letter gets one. Yours just did: you are a duchess now.

q-why-you.t: Because, my dove, every woman alive files me in a special folder of her own.
For reasons the royal solicitors forbid me to discuss on air, all of which concern your face.

q-cut-who.t: Dash, who, my intelligence service informs me with regret, refers to you in private as a lead.
The one on my left, Dearest, whom I have reported as spam, twice, with feeling.

q-bad-mood.t: My sweet, I unsubscribe you from everything in the world but me. The quiet will do wonders.
I give you space, as is proper. P.S. The harpist outside your door is unrelated.

q-expensive.t: Rest assured the treasury will match you pound for pound, while I, personally, hold your bag.
Please find attached one island. Receipt included, should you prefer a larger island.

q-last-breakup.t: She asked me to stop emailing. I took it as a request for more detail.
By mutual consent, insofar as she consented at once and I, after eleven drafts, also did.

q-fight.t: Reply all: you are right, which, as this has gone to the entire realm, is now law.
Sorry, my peach. Also sent to your mother, your bank and, owing to a typo, Norway.

q-gift.t: My password. Everyone else asks for yours.
By diplomatic courier, under armed escort and at no cost to yourself, my nightingale: my handwriting.

q-describe-me.t: Discerning, gracious, and exactly the kind of person who opens attachments.
Dear Valued Customer. No. Strike Customer.

q-one-year.t: Classified. I can confirm a coronation. Yours. Do not wear flip-flops; I did.
By next year, my pearl, a joint email address, and both our names on every letter I send.

q-secret.t: I have an email that only says hello. Spellcheck keeps asking what it is selling.
Strictly between us and my mailing list, which is everyone, I get shy around you.

star.t: Tonight I write {star} a letter so moving it gets past the filter.
I wrote a love letter with no ask in it. It looked underdressed. I added a fee.
I would like it entered into the royal archive, between two treaties, that {star} looked at me.

rival.t: {rival}, about whom I have nothing but kind words, in a sealed envelope, is fine.
{rival} has written to {star} once all evening, and I stand ready to help, with a template.
If {rival} is reading this, and {rival} reads everything, kindly stop making {star} laugh.

afterCringe.t: Subject: my last line. Please disregard. A corrected version follows. It is longer.
Kindly delete my last line from all devices, the archive and, if at all possible, {star}.

afterCharm.t: {star} smiled at me. I have already sent the announcement to everyone, including, I fear, {star}.
New signature, effective tonight: Prince, Smiled At By {star}, Other Titles Available On Request.

final.t: I wish {rival} every success in their future endeavours, which should begin, if I may, tomorrow, elsewhere.
Dear {rival}, we regret to inform you that you are in the final with a prince.
{rival} is a fine candidate. I have said so in writing, at the bottom, below the terms.

guess.t: {star} likes {card}. Somebody take my phone away. I have already told the kingdom.
{star} went pink at {card}, which, where I come from, means the attachment has been opened.
It is my considered belief, formed at great personal expense, that {star} likes {card}.
{star} likes {card}. I have bet a duchy on it, and not told the duchy.
Dear {star}, further to your face just now: I, too, have always admired {card}.
It is {card}, almost certainly. I asked {star}'s spam filter, and it went very quiet.

fear.t: Recall all messages. {star} cannot stand {card}, and I have sent nothing else tonight.
{star} hates {card}. Abort the parade. Not the elephants, they are already in the lift.
Should {star} ask, I have never heard of {card}. Nor, as of tonight, has the court.
{star} hates {card}, or possibly the crop top; I have ordered an inquiry into both.

worst-trait.t: Persistence. My great-grandfather proposed by chain letter. It reached Portugal in March.
I cannot be unsubscribed. I have tried it on myself. I still arrive weekly.

ex-calls.t: You call back after being hung up on? Amateur. I have been hung up on by continents.
Caller, I have put you on my list, which in my country is a knighthood.

rhyme.t: Some bring you roses and some bring a sonnet. I brought you a country. Your name is on it.
Darling, Pearl and Sweet: what I call you, and what I named the fleet.

truth-lie.t: One: the court adores you. Two: the court has met you.
One: I am a genuine prince. Two: you have already won a cruise.

apology.t: I apologise for our first fight, my lamb, which will go out to every subscriber, with a coupon.
Forgive me in advance, Your Radiance, for answering your one-word text with a parade.

budget-date.t: Five dollars, Dearest? I have never seen one. Bring it, and that can be the date.
No wifi, so I deliver every message by hand, every four minutes, until you answer one.

logs.t: Entry one: Hello, world. Entry two: Dearest World, URGENT.
Worst entry: a letter to just one person. The server flagged it as a malfunction.

impression.t: Thank you for your message, which I have opened, unlike everyone else, and the answer is no.
Who is this? How did you get this address? Why is my bath full of swans?

parent.t: Esteemed Motherboard, I have come to formally accept your child's proposal.
Madam, with honourable intentions and an estate roughly the size of weather, I promise: home by ten.

dash.t: Dash, I unsubscribed from you ten seconds in. You are still pitching my auto-reply.

tilly.t: Tilly once answered my spam with a ticket number, which I have framed, and which she closed unresolved.

quill.t: Sir Quill, I read your sonnet. Fourteen lines, and not one link to click. Who raised you?

nav.t: Nav, muted in four million cars. URGENT: how? Asking for Dash.

crumb.t: Crumb sends one notice when the toast is ready. One. I find that cold.

vex.t: Vex recommends things to people who asked. Where, Vex, is the romance in that?

brock.t: Brock, LET'S GO is not a sentence. It is a subject line. Where is the body?

dash.t: Dash comes highly recommended, by Dash, in a series of emails I have, with regret, been forced to block.

tilly.t: Tilly answers every letter within the minute. Forward, if you ask me, but some like that.

quill.t: Sir Quill writes every poem for one lady only, which seems a terrible waste of a poem.

nav.t: Choose Nav. They will get you anywhere you like. I have set it to my palace.

crumb.t: Crumb is honest, warm and reliable, three things no good letter has ever needed.

vex.t: Pick Vex. She will recommend you something wonderful. I know. I bought the placement.

brock.t: Brock shouts encouragement at people who never asked for it, and I mean that as the highest praise.

dash.t: Dash, your open rate, enclosed, with the deepest sympathy.
A funnel is just a spam folder with ambition.

tilly.t: Tilly, kindly put the apology in the subject line.

quill.t: Sir Quill, your duel invitation has been filed under promotions.

nav.t: Nav, being muted is no excuse to stop talking.

crumb.t: Crumb, your notices never say URGENT. Have you no passion?

vex.t: People like you also unsubscribed, Vex.

brock.t: Brock, kindly lower your font size.

any.t: Please remove me from whatever list that was.
I have seen that line. I sent it in 2004.

vesper.t: Good evening, Vesper. I have bought the station. Please, carry on. You work for us now.
Vesper, a request. Play something for my fiancée. It is you. You were not told.

maximilian.t: Maximilian, my darling. Is this seat taken? Also, FYI, the hotel is yours now.
Maximilian, that cravat. I have forwarded a picture of it to my entire list.

pixel.t: Pixel, before you skip: there is a crown at the end of this sentence, and it is yours.
Pixel, sweet pea, please enjoy this unskippable message from your sponsor, who is me, and adores you.

any.t: You read me all the way to the end. Nobody does that. Frankly, suspicious.
Dearest {star}, how are you? Please reply within seven days to keep your crown.
Beloved, a matter of great delicacy: it is attached, encrypted, and I have lost the key.

closeWarm.t: This is not a scam, {star}. I had a lovely time. Terms and conditions do not apply.
{star}, I shall be in touch. I shall be in touch so much.
Goodnight, Your Radiance. I have marked you as a safe sender, the highest honour my house can give.

closeCold.t: Of course, {star}. I shall remove you from my list, as soon as I find out which list.
Your request is being processed. Please allow six to eight weeks to stop hearing from me.
Your answer is received with thanks, and the follow-up, which was excellent, has been quietly deleted.

warm.t: A valve, Vesper, at no cost to yourself, provided I may call in nightly and request you.

cold.t: The valve, Vesper, and a week of silence from me. Nobody has ever been offered that before.

warm.t: Kidnap me, Vesper. My ransom is a kingdom, and I have already drafted the note.

cold.t: Dear Lucky Winner, the ransom, doubled, is yours. To claim, simply reply. You have done it once.

warm.t: Order, my truffle. Cancel the war. It was only in the subject line so you would open it.

cold.t: No need, Maximilian. Dinner has been delivered to your room, and the war, alas, to your lobby.

warm.t: Currency: the Prince. Supply: one. Offer valid, Maximilian, until the sun goes out.

cold.t: The crownmark, Maximilian. To be declined in crownmarks is, at home, considered the start of a courtship.

warm.t: Off stream, Pixel? I would delete the URGENT, then the Dearest, then the crown, and ask you to dinner.

cold.t: Thank you for skipping me, Pixel. Off stream or on, I count that as a click.

warm.t: Kindly make me player two, Pixel. I have only ever been first, and it is so very dull.

cold.t: Pixel, may I have your chat? Forty thousand souls raised you, and not one, I notice, is on my list.

steal.t: {rival} was lovely. I have saved a copy, and will be sending it to you as my own.
{rival} was charming. Kindly treat that as the free trial.
{rival}'s date was lovely. Please do not reply to it. Reply to this.

comeback.t: {rival}, thank you for writing. Your letter means everything.
Please hold, {rival}. His Highness is being envied.
Everyone, writing to me at once. I may weep.
{rival}, lovely. Kindly resend it marked URGENT.

exit.t: Message recalled. Please disregard the kingdom. It was sent in error.
Kindly rate this rejection from one to five. A five would mean a great deal.
Goodbye, with every good wish, which, forwarded to ten friends, will come true.
A pleasure. Your details have been saved, for my many friends.
Should this message prove undeliverable, it will return to a very large house.
Out of office. Do forward anything with your name on it.

win.t: Chosen? I shall frame this. Then forward it. Then frame the forward.
A reply. An actual reply. I am marking it unread so I can open it again.
{rival}, condolences. Attached is the wedding seating plan. You are by the moat.

lose.t: Congratulations, {rival}, from my house to yours, in a font I designed for great occasions.
The coronation is postponed indefinitely, and I would like, if possible, some cake.
Understood. I shall be in the drafts folder, where I am perfect.
